company.name: Perplexity
company.shortDescription: Perplexity is an AI-powered platform that retrieves, analyzes information from the web to deliver structured answers with cited sources.
company.description: Perplexity interprets user queries using large language models and performs real-time searches across multiple data sources to compile relevant insights. It provides features such as conversational querying, contextual follow-up, and model selection for different response types. The platform includes advanced capabilities such as iterative deep research, in which multiple searches and source evaluations are conducted automatically to produce comprehensive outputs. Each response is accompanied by references, enabling verification and further exploration of original materials.

aiResearchSummary.text: Perplexity is researching an augmented search engine and a compact search client for accessing an augmented search engine. The augmented search engine receives an initial query, uses a search state database to determine a next search phase, and may request additional user input to refine results. The compact search client handles verbal queries and communicates with this engine, enabling interactive, stateful, and adaptive query processing; together these efforts focus on augmented search workflows and voice driven search interfaces.
